target_customer: Enterprise teams in sales, marketing and customer service wanting AI email agents, now internal AI tooling for companies
problem: Enterprise teams spend hours on email and routine work. Proxis builds AI agents that draft and send replies and automate workflows.
business_model: B2B enterprise AI services and software
product_category: Enterprise AI agents, starting with email

founders.name: Liam Collins
education: City University of Hong Kong (dual degree)
Left Wharton MBA to build Proxis
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was a software engineer for about two years and a renewable energy investment banker, employers not named.

technical_complexity.rationale: Fine-tuning and distilling LLMs, later agent orchestration over email and enterprise systems. Standard applied LLM engineering for 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Email agents are easy to replicate with off-the-shelf models, and many AI sales and email tools exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Email assistants from the major email platforms are an obvious substitute; no source found on specific incumbent action against Proxis.

market_need_then: Interest in LLM automation of enterprise email was rising in 2024, but no hard evidence of demand for Proxis specifically was found.

identity.logo: A P tile appears on directory listings
identity.voice_and_tone: Ambitious, mission to give founders an army of agents

branding.community_and_virality: None found. A Belgian firm and Praxis companies share similar names.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press or community found and the name is confusable with Proxy and Praxis names.

pivots.to: Internal AI tooling for enterprises with consumer app Gabber and a skills marketplace
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from the current site versus the YC description, date unknown

outcome_analysis: Proxis is Active with a solo named founder and a team of 3. Its message moved from email agents to broader internal AI tools, and it released a consumer app called Gabber, which suggests a search for a market. No funding beyond YC could be verified and no exit is reported. There is not enough evidence for a clear success or failure story.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators (Startups.fm, VCBacked) show about $500K pre-seed from YC and Pioneer Fund in September 2024; no primary source, so no round recorded. Competitor search returned only 2026-era sales email tools (Lavender, Instantly), nothing dated near the batch, so the list is empty. Confidence is low because only one founder was found and funding and competition are unsourced. The pivot is inferred from site wording. Completeness pass: The pre-seed round rests on a single database (VCBacked, repeated by Startups.fm and Extruct). Cross-check search found no primary source.
